guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: productcatalogservice exhibits the highest anomaly scores with a 10x memory spike (z=+207) and massive error/latency increases, indicating a memory leak or OOM condition is driving the incident. Traces and frontend logs confirm requests fail when reaching this service, directly correlating with the observed resource exhaustion.

proposed_fix.description: Restart productcatalogservice pods to reclaim memory and increase memory limits/requests to prevent OOM kills.
